text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: This happened shortly before the summer training camp began...

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, morning classes are finally over!
Hey, hey, let's go grab lunch!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text: Okay. The cafeteria works, right?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (Lunchtime... I'm starving too...)

text_block_list.name: Classmate C
text_block_list.text:
Umm... Ah, there you are, Cheval-chan.
Hey, someone's looking for you!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh? M-Me...?

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, feels so nice...! Just as I thought.
I really wanted to eat outside today.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
So, that's why you called out to me...?
And you even prepared a lunchbox for me...

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text: Fufu, it made me so happy to see Cheval-chan eat so much, as always.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks for keeping me company.
We only have a little time left together, so I just wanted to talk with you as much as possible.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Shine...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(August is just around the corner. You're really...
going, aren't you? To Australia...)

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
"...Geez, don't make that face,
Cheval-chan."

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
I feel lonely too, but...
More than that, the desire to give it my all is so much bigger.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
I'll try all sorts of new methods over there.
...I want to get stronger. And then—

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Cheval-chan.
Could you make just one promise with me?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: A promise...? Wh-What is it?

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to train super hard over there.
So I won't lose to you, Cheval-chan, as you keep getting stronger and stronger.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text: That's why—

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text: Would you compete with me again in the Japan Cup?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...!
The Japan Cup...

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. If it's an International GⅠ open to
overseas competitors, someone could even
come challenge it from Australia, couldn't they?"

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
So, okay?
Let's meet again at the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
Roaring cheers reaching high and far into the sky.
When I stand at the very center of it all—

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text: I want you to be the one who stands as my rival.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, does that mean I lost?

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! ...You caught me?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Geez, that's mean.
...But yeah, you're right.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I see. The Japan Cup—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
Let's make a promise.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
We'll get stronger—
and face each other in the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Let's have the best showdown ever...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And at last, the Senior Year summer training camp began.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As for Cheval Grand,
she wore an expression overflowing with motivation—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
T-That's how... it happened.
Um, I'm sorry for acting on my own, but—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"After the Kyoto Daishoten is the Japan Cup.
May I make that my goal...?"
choice_data_list: Yeah, I think that's a good idea.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's on the longer side distance-wise, which suits Cheval Grand.
Besides, there's no reason to put the brakes
on this motivation of hers.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Yes...?
choice_data_list: We're gonna train hard this summer!
We're going to train hard this summer!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes...!
Yes, um, gladly...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I will... become stronger too.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
So that I can hold my head high when I meet her again...
as she takes flight into a brand new sky.
